description: Elemental Convergence (final) — the six element emblems pop in around a ring one by one (dark, fire, wind, light, earth, water), each flaring in its colour, then spiral inward and fuse into the FantasySoul crest with a flash and a six-colour shockwave; bold MATCH START slams in below; the fully formed crest and lettering hold with a gentle breathing glow and a soft shimmer sweep (~1.0-1.5 s), then fade out slowly (1.5-2.0 s)

overlay.format: WebM, VP9 video with alpha channel (yuva420p, alpha_mode=1), straight/non-premultiplied alpha, no audio track

anchor.placement: draw the 1920x1080 canvas unscaled at 1080p (scale 1:1 with the stage) with its centre on the battlefield centre; in the reference layout that is (954,510), the centre gem of the board divider, i.e. canvas top-left at (-6,-30). Plain stage centre (960,540) also works.

dim.how: full-stage black layer under the overlay, e.g. <div style='position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000;pointer-events:none'> with opacity animated as above
dim.note: dim done by game code under the overlay; it fades out together with the overlay's visual fade-out

endState: overlay fades out smoothly from 1500 ms and is fully transparent by the last frame; remove it when the video ends

sfx.note: start together with the overlay (t=0); its tail fades with the visual fade-out (from 1500 ms)

preview.background: real battlefield screenshot (spell_anim/common/bg_board.png) with the dim applied as specified

sources.fxElements: Kling 3.0 pro clip ms_A from the v1 batch (reused, no new generation), keyed from black to additive light; element-colour glows, rings and sparks rendered in code
sources.lettering: rendered in code in the logo typeface, bold: Google Sans Flex weight 880 (v2 used 550) (SIL OFL, the open release of the Product Sans / Google Sans design the wordmark uses), per-glyph width tuned to the wordmark; gold grain texture sampled from logo_wordmark_stand.png, its measured gradient, dark-red outline and inner rim
sources.sound: re-timed native audio of v1 Kling clip ms_A, layered with synthesized sub thump / body hit / low swell / rumble; loudness-normalised; no sonilo/mirelo

fadeOut.curve: cosine ease-in-out (opacity = (0.5+0.5cos(pi*u))^1.35); every layer (lettering, emblems, glows, particles) fades together; fully transparent on the last frame

changesFromA_final: duration 1500 -> 2000 ms at the user's request, so the lettering can be read: entrance (0-1000 ms) and lettering (Google Sans Flex wght 880, tracking 0.03) are identical to A_final
fully formed hold ~1000-1500 ms (A_final started fading at 1080 ms) with a subtle breathing glow on crest and lettering plus one soft, wide shimmer sweep (1220-1720 ms) so it is not frozen
slow natural fade-out 1500-1983 ms (cosine ease, all layers together), fully transparent on the last frame
dim still done in code, opacity 0.6 black, same fade-in 0-180 ms, fade-out moved to 1500-2000 ms with the visual fade
sound re-fitted to 2.0 s: same layers and hits, low rumble carries the hold, tail fades with the visual fade from 1500 ms
changesFromV2: lettering much bolder: Google Sans Flex wght 880 (v2: 550), stem/cap 0.168 -> ~0.28, tracking 0.02 -> 0.03; same logo-sampled gold texture, outline and bevel
natural fade-out 1080-1483 ms (cosine ease) replacing the late, steep fade
(2.0 s version) duration 1500 -> 2000 ms at the user's request, so the lettering can be read: entrance (0-1000 ms) and lettering (Google Sans Flex wght 880, tracking 0.03) are identical to A_final
